reusable: Any local project can read this file. A second copy lives at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Fonia\resources\dev-catalog.json. Paths below are evidence from this PC. The choice of stack is the same on another machine once its own install check is written here.

audit.note: Counted package.json dependencies under A.I projects and nearby project folders, skipping node_modules. Python names are from the Python 3.12 pip list. A library that appears only inside a requirements file is declared, not installed in that interpreter.

tools.name: Next.js
tools.when: A website, dashboard, or web app. Use the Next.js App Router with React. Do not start a plain HTML page when this workspace depends on next, or when the user asked for a website.

tools.name: React
tools.when: The interface layer inside Next.js or Vite. This is the repeating UI library on this PC.

tools.name: TypeScript
tools.when: New web and Node code in a project that already has TypeScript.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.when: Styling for a Next.js or Vite interface that already uses Tailwind.

tools.name: Vite
tools.when: Stay on Vite when the open workspace is a Vite app. Do not convert it to Next.js in the same task.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.when: Auth and database in a project that already depends on @supabase/supabase-js.

tools.name: Zod
tools.when: Validate input in a TypeScript project that already depends on zod.

tools.name: Recharts
tools.when: Charts in a React page. chart.js was not in the repeating set.

tools.name: three.js
tools.when: A 3D or interactive section. Use three with @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei inside the existing Next.js or Vite app. Do not replace the whole site with a raw three.js page.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.when: Browser checks in a project that already depends on playwright. This Fonia app uses node:test, not Playwright, for its intent tests.

tools.name: Vitest
tools.when: Unit tests in a Vite project that already has vitest.

tools.name: Express
tools.when: A small Node HTTP API when the workspace already uses Express.

tools.name: node-postgres
tools.when: Postgres from Node when the workspace already depends on pg. Prisma was not found.

tools.name: React Hook Form
tools.when: Forms in a React project that already depends on it.

tools.name: Framer Motion
tools.when: Motion in a React project that already depends on framer-motion.

tools.name: React Native
tools.when: A phone app. Expo is declared in 3 of these projects. Use Kivy only inside a handnote project that already lists it.

tools.name: FastAPI
tools.when: A Python API. FastAPI and uvicorn are on the Python 3.12 interpreter. Also declared in ComplyIQ, task-a-review-webapp, and whatsapp-ai-bot.

tools.name: httpx
tools.when: HTTP from Python. It is on the interpreter. For HTML, Beautiful Soup 4.14.3 is also on this interpreter.

tools.name: better-sqlite3
tools.when: Local SQLite inside this Fonia app only. Do not add it to an unrelated website.

tools.name: Node.js
tools.when: JavaScript and Next.js work. npm and pnpm are on PATH. yarn is not.

tools.name: Python
tools.when: Python 3.12 is installed. Use it for FastAPI and scripts. Do not assume every library in a requirements file is installed in this interpreter.

tools.name: Git
tools.when: Source control.

tools.name: ffmpeg
tools.when: Video frames and microphone audio. Already used by Fonia.

tools.name: Docker
tools.when: Containers when the user asks. Do not start a new database container for a task that the workspace already solves with Supabase or a local file.

tools.name: .NET
tools.when: A C# project when one is open. It is not the repeating website stack.

tools.name: Java
tools.when: A Java project when one is open. JDK 17 is installed. It is not the repeating website stack.

tools.name: Django
tools.when: Django 6.1.2 is on the Python 3.12 interpreter, and codeerax already lists it. A new website still uses Next.js.

tools.name: Flask
tools.when: Flask 3.0.0 is on the Python 3.12 interpreter, and the microblog project already lists it. A new website still uses Next.js.

tools.name: Pillow
tools.when: Image files in codeerax, whose requirements list Pillow. It is not on the global interpreter.

tools.name: Kivy
tools.when: handnote already lists Kivy. A new phone app on this PC uses React Native and Expo.

tools.name: Beautiful Soup
tools.when: HTML parsing. beautifulsoup4 4.14.3 is on the Python 3.12 interpreter.

tools.name: cheerio
tools.when: HTML parsing in Node. It was not in the scanned package.json files.

tools.name: Prisma
tools.when: Prisma is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Fonia\resources\web-libs for another project. It is not a dependency of this Fonia app. Use Supabase or pg when the open project already has them.

tools.name: Stripe
tools.when: The stripe package is in the Fonia resources folder. It is not wired into Fonia. A payment still needs your own Stripe key.

tools.name: pandas
tools.when: Tables in Python. Not on the interpreter. Do not import it until it is installed.

tools.name: Leaflet
tools.when: leaflet and mapbox-gl are in the Fonia resources folder. Mapbox still needs your own token. Neither package is part of this Fonia app.

tools.name: Go
tools.when: Go is not installed. A new service on this PC uses Node or FastAPI.

tools.name: Rust
tools.when: Rust and Cargo are not installed.

tools.name: PHP
tools.when: PHP and Composer are not installed. A website uses Next.js.
